name: HUNT0

sources.title: Homepage — 'Ship Early. Hunt Early.' community-ranked weekly launch leaderboard; active weekly board with dozens of products

Submit page — 6-step form (product info, description, media, categories/tags, launch schedule, social links); three launch methods: Free community queue (70 slots/week), Badge Launch ($0 with badge verification), Premium $16.90 one-time; sign-in required

conditions: Free Launch queues into a weekly community board capped at 70 slots — the earliest free week shown was ~3 months out ('skip up to 91 days of waiting' on paid tiers), and dofollow links only go to the weekly top 20
Badge Launch is also $0 and skips the queue with a guaranteed dofollow backlink — but requires displaying/verifying HUNT0's badge on your domain (eligible domains only)
requirements: Sign-in required at the end of the submit flow
Full product package: name, tagline, pricing, markdown description, square logo, 1-9 gallery images (PNG/JPG/WebP ≤10MB), up to 3 categories, up to 10 tags
At least one social link (X, GitHub, LinkedIn, Bluesky, YouTube) plus contact email
For Badge Launch: ability to place their badge on your site for verification
preparation: Contact email and at least one social URL
Decide free-queue vs badge vs premium: free waits ~3 months; $0 badge needs badge placement; $16.90 skips everything
workflow: Step 1: product name, tagline, link (AI Autofill available), pricing
Step 3: upload logo and gallery images
Step 5: choose launch method (Free queue / Badge / Premium) and launch week
Step 6: add social links + contact email, then sign in to submit
watchFor: The free queue is long — ~91 days to the earliest open week; treat this as a slow-burn listing, not a launch-day channel
Free listings only earn a dofollow link if they reach the weekly top 20 — most won't
Badge Launch is the smarter $0 route if you're willing to host their badge
Premium price shown as $16.90 marked down from $29.90 — pricing may fluctuate
Board is AI-tool-heavy with low vote counts (0-8 votes typical) — community reach is small
countsAsLive: The product appears on the HUNT0 weekly leaderboard for its scheduled launch week and has a public product page
unknowns: What 'eligible domains' means for Badge Launch verification
Whether free listings that miss top-20 get nofollow links or no link at all
How long listings persist after their launch week
